contractBoundary.role: Logical mapping and typed profile registry; not a replacement for native SDK schemas or an implemented adapter.
contractBoundary.fieldHintSemantics: observedFields are conservative type hints for known native members or explicitly noted normalized envelopes. Absence remains absent; these hints do not invent native requiredness or coerce unknown values.
contractBoundary.rawPayloadPolicy: Retain exact source JSON/envelope, including unknown members, enums, unions, scalars and null. Projection failure records a diagnostic and preserves source evidence.
contractBoundary.unknownProfilePolicy: Retain a versioned Source with unsupported-profile diagnostics; do not invent a normalized result or silently discard the original content.
contractBoundary.sourceIdentityPolicy: Source logical identity is the owning provider tuple, representation, profile and source operation, independent of content digest or native version. Connections authorize access; they do not define native identity.
contractBoundary.writePolicy: Profile descriptors do not authorize native writes. Phase 1 includes specifications only; commands that reach AWS need a separately implemented, authorized, idempotency-aware adapter.
contractBoundary.projectionPolicy: Only normalizedBinding.projectionProfile names are Projection profile values. Other console profiles bind Source.profile as LOCAL_EVIDENCE or declared owned values. Each entity uses the common version mechanism.
contractBoundary.versionPolicy: Every entity has stable identity plus version, createdAt and updatedAt. Exact references select (kind,id,version). Owned values inherit the owning entity version. Versions are not separate domain entities.

mappings.preservedSemantics: Keep the full provider event ARN. Event counts do not multiply by context, receipt, or delivery.

Retain the provider event-type catalog object, including unknown classifications; it does not replace an observed event classification. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.
Unique workspace/event/kind/non-null contextKey. PUBLIC has no affected-account or organization link; ACCOUNT has exactly one account; ORG_SUMMARY has exactly one organization and owns no impacts.
Pin contextual source evidence and field presence. Summary absence does not erase hydrated detail. Event status, provider time and local observation time remain separate.
Locale and text belong to the exact event-context revision. The latest-description API does not provide an independent provider history entity.
An event-relative construct may be a resource, group or broader marker. Preserve provisional local ID and optional Health entity ARN. Supplied account must agree with ACCOUNT context.
Entity provider-update time is independent of parent event time; repeat reads do not create another impact.
Preserve partition and string account ID. Names and ownership are external enrichment; receipt is not impact or membership evidence.
Preserve external organization identity and scope; Health does not return a complete organization directory.
Time-bounded account/organization relation with source evidence. Historical visibility can outlast current membership.
Observed integration state differs from requested state and backfill completeness; an empty enable/disable acknowledgement proves neither readiness nor coverage.
Zero, one or several verified resource matches, each with method, confidence and exact evidence. Unresolved values and groups remain valid.
Local communication identity differs from raw AWS communicationId. Preserve notification-account context, grouping method, expected pages, conflicts and assembly state.
Preserve exact raw communicationId and page number. Group a page suffix only when validated; require expected pages before claiming complete membership.
Raw envelope is an exact Source; Observation records receipt. Logical page dedupe excludes backup delivery region/envelope ID; receipt metadata never becomes affected-account attribution.
A collection/access path with capabilities, authorization context and monitored scope. Changing role/connection does not change native identity.
A bounded collection owns attempts for each operation/page, including empty successes and failures; pagination completion applies only to that query.
Retain event/account-specific failedSet errors even when transport status is 200. Batch success is not inferred from HTTP status.
Pin query scope, page chain, errors, unavailable capabilities, freshness and policy. A snapshot freezes these values; later collection cannot improve old coverage.
Source retains the document under stable identity/version; Observation is one receipt occurrence and pins its exact Source version. API, EventBridge and local channels retain their actual context.

Retain the exact captured query and aggregate payload; scope and pagination remain qualified rather than implying a global total. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.
Use stable local identity and retained Source versions; service/version is not a provider-guaranteed unique key. Preserve unresolved recommendedVersion.
Owner-local milestone identity/order, explicit date/type/risks/regions and exact entry revision. A new date does not erase prior history; missing regions is not all regions.
Inventory identity is external and independent of Health entity identity. Resolve by qualified evidence, never name alone.
One observed resource component/version and its exact source/time. A resource can host multiple components; current inventory is not historical inventory.
Pin deployment evidence and milestone revision. Record applicability, method, confidence, rule version and cutoff; ambiguous/no match remains unknown.
Local owner/priority/due/workflow, independent verification state/evidence and concurrency version; completing work never changes provider entity state or independently observed deployment.

mappings.representation: WorkItem.targets[] (EntityIdentity); exact evidence is separate from live work targeting
mappings.preservedSemantics: Each target is exactly one typed context, impact or exposure reference. Several targets can coordinate one item without inventing a provider incident-group ID.

mappings.representation: WorkItem.actions[] (WorkAction) with exact evidenceRefs and Command receipts
mappings.preservedSemantics: Append actor/time/action/evidence and local version under the work aggregate; retain source statements for provenance. An action audit is not provider success.
Summary/detail wrappers represent existing event/context identities; representation and present fields remain explicit.
Provider batch errors retain exact shape/code and scoped item references. Do not fabricate missing successful items.

mappings.representation: Collection.queries[] (CollectionQuery.filters/window/requestDigest) and ReadAttempt.requestSource; native filter syntax remains retained
mappings.preservedSemantics: These are request/cursor values, not operational identities. Save exact effective query; keep native tokens opaque and separate from application cursors.
Partition/owning account/Region plus service-specific parent scope. Unambiguously encode opaque IDs; connection role is not native identity.
Separate access/caching/export scope from source ownership. Current authorization still applies to historical data.
Scoped native Agent Space; it is not the console Workspace. Retain ARN aliases when supplied.
An integration registration is not a workload Service. Built-in serviceId aws need not resolve to one; preserve independent native identity.
Own association ID/configuration discriminator and optional registration resolution. Do not require serviceId uniqueness within a space.
Keep system/referenceId/URL/associationId and unresolved historical association; an external alert/ticket is not replaced by task linking.

mappings.representation: Native INVESTIGATION Task facet; other Task kinds retained
mappings.preservedSemantics: Only INVESTIGATION tasks normalize as Investigation. EVALUATION, RELEASE_READINESS_REVIEW and RELEASE_TESTING remain retained aws.devops-agent.task/v1 Source payloads, not typed normalized task DTOs.
Explicit link observed from task-scoped ListExecutions request. Execution has no native taskId; allow multiple observed memberships and deduplicate repeated membership evidence.
Scoped execution identity; explicit parent can remain unresolved. Task.executionId is a pointer, not proof of latest/root/only run. STOPPED is preserved.
Scoped space/execution/record ID, open recordType, createdAt and arbitrary JSON content. Preserve unknown types/scalars/null.

Stable source identity and exact entity version retain the payload, representation and declared digest. The source alias names a retained version; it does not become a separate revision entity or a claimed native Journal revision API.
The collision-free owning tuple/channel/native key is an owned SourceIdentity value on versioned Source. It is independent of content digest and access credentials.
EvidenceRef pins kind, id and version with an optional typed EvidenceLocator. Distinct locations remain distinct citations without creating another entity or substituting current content.
Immutable ordinary Projection versions preserve typed result/timeline/assertion value, derivation and output digest; no revision entity is added.
Exact parser/rule/model identities and method distinguish source mapping, deterministic parsing, operator statements and application inference.
Collection records bounded queries and lifecycle plus exact collector and selectionPolicy identities. Historical missing processing metadata is unknown.

Every request attempt keeps its identity across STARTED and settled versions. requestSource and nullable responseSource pin exact Source versions, including empty successful envelopes. Missing response remains unknown. Snapshot.members references the attempt version instead of copying another authoritative entity.
Repeat receipt of unchanged content adds observation history without creating new logical records or revisions. Non-read channels do not invent ReadAttempts.
Coverage preserves query/window/dimensions/read attempts plus exact evaluationPolicy identity, separate from source completeness and provider state.
Typed timeline with stable item IDs, explicit grouping, independent source/evidence/receipt clocks, availability, exact sources, derivation and supersession; no provider order is invented.

Distinct typed application assertion kind with exact subjects/source evidence, provenance and published content. Action stages have independent observations; no private reasoning or native universal result schema is claimed.

Distinct typed application assertion kind with exact subjects/source evidence, provenance and published content. Action stages have independent observations; no private reasoning or native universal result schema is claimed.
Select per investigation/mitigation phase by exact completion pointer when present; preserve missing-pointer, no-summary-reported and unavailable-reference states.
Explicit namespace/ID/URL and resolution provenance. A connection, same-space location or temporal adjacency is not implication or consumption evidence.

Preserve JOURNAL/CHAT_STREAM/A2A/NATIVE_ASSET/EXTERNAL source channel and exact source, native ID and optional evidence-supported Asset version resolution; missing/access-denied/unsupported/deleted remain distinct.
GraphContents names the graph-view meaning and owns typed nodes/edges, exact evidence and processing metadata; all capture history uses Snapshot.version.
Snapshot-owned nodeKind, explicit resolution/placeholder state and assertion metadata retain evidence and origin; unknown fields on legacy captures stay unknown.
Snapshot-owned endpoints, relationKind, claimKind and assertion metadata preserve operator/agent/application provenance, source confidence and validity; endpoints stay within the same graph.
Space-scoped native asset and open type. Same Agent Space does not imply that a task used or produced it.

Each Asset version carries the exact nativeVersion, Source reference and files. Application version and native version remain distinct. No embedded AssetVersion history array or version-only entity is created. Requested attachment IDs do not establish consumed content.
Exact asset version and path; preserve bytes/text representation and content digest. A file version is an asset version, not a separate invented native counter.

Immutable capture manifest with task/membership/results/sources/projections, frozen coverage and explicit captureStartedAt/captureFinishedAt. capturedAt does not replace these boundaries or provider times. A later continued investigation creates new evidence.
Exact Source versions plus captured attempt/page/coverage evidence. A later successful refresh cannot improve captured coverage.
Pin exact Source or Projection members as EntityRef(kind,id,version). Historical source names projectionRevisionId/sourceRevisionIds are not fields in the current model.
Preserve native content unions, session scope, queue versus history distinction and attribution. Chat response completion is not task completion.
Only supplied native userId/userType are facts. Native attribution is not a trusted ActorRef and absence remains unknown.
Own response/session/block identities and sequence when supplied; preserve partial JSON, gaps and unknown branches. Stream cursor/parentage is not durable Journal identity.
Observed request Source/digest is pinned; validated invocation preserves interruptId/toolUseId and requested ApprovalPattern. Unsupported/missing-ID requests never imply dispatchability.
Requested pattern binds through ApprovalRequest.invocation and final decision through Command.approvalDecision. Preserve tool/argumentPins exactly; never widen scope.

A typed ApprovalDecisionIntent reconstructs exact decision, scope and requested context. Only exact requested-pattern single-use approvals are exposed; decision, resume and action effect remain separate.
Separate command related to accepted decision. Stream-open does not prove resumed effect; lost-response uncertainty never triggers a blind mutating retry.
Keep genuine space-scoped goal identity, lifecycle/version, typed content and scheduling/last-task relations. It is not a Scenario or an investigation completion.
Keep native recommendationId/taskId and optional goal/version with its native lifecycle and priority. This provider identity is distinct from the source-scoped Resilience suggestion identity.
Separate native automation resource with schedule union/open action; not an Asset or executable console Scenario. Current custom-agent links are not historical consumption.
Provider access configuration belongs to its Agent Space; it is not console authentication or investigation fact.
Keep provider name/ARN/network/certificate/state; it is not the console Connection access path.
Provider intake descriptor scoped to its association; configuration does not prove receipt of any incident/event.
Scoped usage-window metrics and limits; not incident telemetry, runtime success, or task recovery.
Keep provider filter combinations and exact order; a task leaving a filtered page is not deletion. No generic updated-since feed is implied.
Preserve type catalog, source URL and text/bytes/ZIP members. GetAssetContent carries ZIP bytes in JSON content.zipFile; native/upload limits remain adapter-specific.
Known typed provider unions with raw unknown variants retained. Strict native write validation is separate from tolerant output ingestion.
Scoped native mutable template; pin observed configuration. It is not a Scenario; no provider revision guarantee is invented.
Native catalog identity and retrieval revision. A catalog action ID does not identify each named runtime use.

Native identity, member keys, configuration and unknown fields remain inspectable in the exact versioned Source. This is intentionally retained-only; no typed owned class or administrative operation is claimed. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object, not an AWS response envelope.

Scoped native experiment identity with frozen run configuration. May exist without a console Run; a StepAttempt can explicitly refer to it.
Experiment/action-name identity, raw state/reason/times and parameters. No independent stop/retry/pause operation is implied.

Experiment-owned predecessor/successor names retain duplicate-free edges. Known cycles and self-edges are invalid in every mode. COMPLETE and legacy omission retain closed-reference endpoint validation; explicit PARTIAL/UNKNOWN permits unloaded endpoints. The legacy validation policy does not certify provider hydration, and an acyclic partial observed graph does not prove complete-graph validity.

Experiment.targetSelections preserves exact native targetName even for an empty resolution. TargetMembership.targetName and FISAction.targetBindings values join the same experiment-local selector; selectionKey remains opaque.
Action-name/slot-to-selector link with owning experiment scope.

Native identity, member keys, configuration and unknown fields remain inspectable in the exact versioned Source. This is intentionally retained-only; no typed owned class or administrative operation is claimed. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object, not an AWS response envelope.
Experiment-owned membership identity is selectionKey; targetName is the separate exact selector join. Preserve raw targetInformation through selectionObservation and optional inventory normalization.
Qualified type/account/Region/native key and match provenance. EKS pod scope includes cluster/namespace/name; container selection remains membership detail.
Resolution-ended evidence and exhausted page traversal are independent. A complete empty page does not by itself establish empty resolved scope.
Exact source record/location with action/selector/account associations; top-level FIS log id is experiment ID, not an event ID.
Preserve raw provider status, source timestamp and observation/capture interval; receipt order does not establish lifecycle order.
Report generation/readiness is independent of experiment execution and assessment. Eligibility/configuration presence and retrieval errors remain explicit.
Exact artifact descriptor/ARN/type and version/digest when known; access is authorized separately, and presence does not imply evaluation success.

Native identity, member keys, configuration and unknown fields remain inspectable in the exact versioned Source. This is intentionally retained-only; no typed owned class or administrative operation is claimed. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object, not an AWS response envelope.
Qualified external alarm identity. Alarm state/history is separately observed evidence, not an experiment aggregate.
Exact state/transition with source/time/coverage; experiment termination cannot fabricate an alarm transition.
Partition/account/Region is a provider ownership value, not tenant identity or a credential grant.
Scoped native safety control; unknown hydration does not remove the native one-per-supported-scope relation. Writes remain explicit future adapter commands.

Source identity/version pins qualified query, unit, period and normalization. Typed experiment evaluation contents reference that exact Source; the original native metric profile remains raw evidence.

Snapshot EVALUATION_INPUT contents with contractProfile console.telemetry.evaluation-input/v1 owns exact Experiment/query/criterion associations, windows, anchor evidence and accepted evidence. No Run is required.

Typed Source payload pins exact query, numeric samples, unit, period, event window and normalization; bounded coverage and collection remain separate. Raw AWS payloads remain aws.cloudwatch.metric/v1 evidence.

Exact criterion Source version pins numeric threshold/comparison, units, missing-data policy, stability, timing anchor, optional recovery rule, predicate and evaluator digests. Snapshot binds it to an exact experiment/query/window.

Local immutable evaluation, not native ResilienceAssessment. New evidence/rule/cutoff creates another EVALUATION revision over a frozen input Snapshot; an orchestration Run is optional. Preserve every historical assessment of an experiment.
Exact accepted Source versions/observations and evaluation cutoff, scoped to the Run through retained/imported references.
One stable scenarioId with common version metadata. DRAFT editing, PUBLISHED definition and ARCHIVED admission policy are states of successive Scenario versions. Names and digests are not identity.

mappings.representation: Scenario at an exact PUBLISHED version
mappings.preservedSemantics: The source publication concept becomes a Scenario version with locked operation/schema/implementation/runtime contracts and digest. Run pins that exact version. Later draft/archive versions cannot mutate the published program.

Run pins a published Scenario version and admission Snapshot version. Each Run version pins exact StepRun versions; historical verdicts cannot join current children. Execution outcome, acceptance and finalization remain separate.

One identity per compiled main/finalizer step, including skipped steps. selectedAttempt pins an exact StepAttempt version; attemptNo remains a retry index on the attempt. Parent runId is ownership, not permission to resolve a historical run through current children.

Unique (stepRunId,attemptNo), durable dispatch/effect intent, evidence and checkpoints. Poll/resume does not create a new attempt; ambiguous effects fence retries. AttemptRecovery pins once-resolved inputs, typed checkpoint schema/content and structured technical error; same-attempt resume retains identity.

Evidence remains on shared Source/Observation. Run.evidenceCitations is the owned role manifest with exact producer/consumer attempts or declared imported origin. Capture closure selects the exact Run version and its input snapshot, steps, attempts and citations; role absence on a legacy capture is not proof of production/import provenance.
Owned stepKey, bindings, inputs, dependencies, timeout/retry/check role and main/finalizer phase belong to the containing Scenario version. They do not have independent version entities.
Exact implementation/input/output schema digests and contract version; unavailable/revoked pin rejects execution without silent substitution.
Exact revision, validated inputs, authorized resource/connection bindings and observed versions, enabled steps, required-criterion denominator and effective policy.
Qualified external references; inventory and credentials remain separate. Resolving a reference never grants permission.

Sealed verdict/reason, predicate and optional evaluator digest, optional actual/expected summaries, exact evidence refs and cutoff. Summaries are explanatory; missing legacy fields are not fabricated.

Source payload under console.workflow.observation/v1 binds typed value availability, collection, coverage, scope, window, timestamps and conversion/schema digests. Consolidated Observation remains the separate receipt entity.
Qualified provider handle plus stable originEffectKey even before remote ID is known. Native Experiment and logs query IDs are references, not a new generic Run.
First accepted principal/time/reason is monotonic, fences new main dispatch, and is independent of confirmed remote stop or cleanup.
Store locator/version/media/length/digest; temporary download URL and access rights resolve separately.

StepAttempt.recovery.error or CommandAttempt.error holds code/category/retry eligibility and safe diagnostics. Assessment false remains CheckResult; retry eligibility alone never authorizes re-dispatch.
Capture handle is an external-operation reference; registry locks and reducer/denominator/finalization values belong to revision/run ownership, not extra CRUD roots.
Console System owns local catalog metadata; verified native ARN/ID is an alias/import fact. ARN-less summaries retain unresolved partial identity, not a fabricated ARN.
One local Service membership authority, with provenance for imported native associatedSystems. Shared services deduplicate by canonical/provider identity, not path count.
Belongs to one System; provider identity includes parent system scope. Local catalog changes never silently update native journey configuration.
Selected journey belongs to the same associated System; derive journey service list from Service membership rather than two writable authorities.
Console business service has opaque canonical identity and local configuration. Native ARN/configuration is an imported facet, not the universal service primary key.
Qualified policy identity with immutable Source versions; direct service/journey assignment stays explicit and no native system policy is invented.
Four typed native components: availabilitySlo, dataRecovery, multiAz, multiRegion. Local performance objectives require a separate namespace and units.
Exact observed target bundle with original source/time; do not independently select latest values when displaying an older posture context.

mappings.representation: Source.effectiveTargets.values (eight typed optional metric members with EffectiveTargetProvenance)
mappings.preservedSemantics: Typed value/unit plus optional policy name and ownership. Name is not policy identity; SELF/CROSS_ACCOUNT is not DIRECT/INHERITED.
Immutable assignment/membership/policy hashes and exact effective-target Source version; observed context does not prove which policy revision AWS evaluated.
Native service/assessment identity. Execution SUCCESS is distinct from policy achievability, runtime health, finding count or verified remediation.
Native service/finding identity and observed summary/detail. Do not require assessment FK; optional same-service capture correlation has an explicit basis.
Capture list/page/detail scope/outcomes and optional qualified assessment correlation. New incomplete capture cannot claim old complete coverage is current.

mappings.representation: Observation.source -> exact Source containing the scoped summary/detail finding evidence
mappings.preservedSemantics: Capture/service/finding/representation plus exact field presence; preserve summary versus detail and incomplete hydration.

mappings.representation: Recommendation (identity/groupKey/ordinal/source); optional normalizedSuggestion (RecommendationContent), raw suggestion and separate enrichment
mappings.preservedSemantics: Without a stable native suggestion key, identity is finding + exact Source version + group/ordinal. Repeated observations of that same Source version reuse Recommendation identity. Ordinals in changed source content do not prove continuity. Enrichment publishes a new Recommendation version.

Title, effort, estimate and note are owned enrichment using Recommendation.version. WorkItem owns assignment and operator state. No nested enrichment version or duplicate owner/workState is maintained. Unknown cost stays unknown; enrichment cannot alter the captured suggestion.

Retain the complete observed discovery object, including provider-managed status, eligibleResourceCount, message, update time and unknown members. Missing remains unknown; desired ENABLED/DISABLED intent is separate. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.
Qualified service/dependency identity and DNS evidence; canonical relation/matches remain optional and sourced. No invented dependency-to-topology FK.

Decision, rationale and audit actor are owned values governed by Dependency.version. Their write authority is local; they cannot alter provider classification, observed traffic or network permissions. There is no separate governance version counter.
Immutable typed graph capture with filters/window/coverage. Resource/edge pages are not an atomic AWS snapshot.
Snapshot-local node identity and optional qualified Resource reference; unresolved endpoint is an explicit stub.
Both endpoints share snapshot; retain every supplied relation/label/type property and provenance. Missing type does not default to data flow.

mappings.representation: EntityRef/SourceIdentity in bound SubjectReference values; Source.subjectState (SubjectStateObservation) preserves visibility and deletion evidence
mappings.preservedSemantics: Typed/scoped provider/canonical key with resolved/unresolved/tombstone state. This is a reference contract, not a universal untyped entity table.
Channel/stream scope/source event ID dedupe, raw envelope and independent source/receipt times. It is not an AWS HealthEvent.
Typed scoped subject/role/link evidence and parent scope; event arrival is refresh evidence, not a completed detail reconciliation.

mappings.representation: Observation.source -> Source.postureEvidence (NativePostureEvidence or DerivedPostureEvidence); immutable Source.normalization provenance
mappings.preservedSemantics: Retain achievability and captured target context with explicit optional assessment correlation. Local finding disposition cannot rewrite posture.

mappings.representation: Observation.source -> Source.healthSignal (HealthSignalEvidence); measurement clocks remain separate from receipt/expiry
mappings.preservedSemantics: Monitoring signal identity, measuredAt, expiry and source; independent of AWS HealthEvent and policy posture. Ties/older observations do not win by arrival.

mappings.representation: Projection(profile=SERVICE_STATUS).value (ServiceStatus); WORKSPACE_SUMMARY uses the separate workspace-summary profile
mappings.preservedSemantics: Separate execution/posture/runtime health/discovery/coverage/attention; retain exact contributor IDs and rule version. Recompute does not renew source freshness.

Retain service-scoped input-source identity, read discriminator and configuration. A read discriminator does not imply a supported native write union. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.

Retain the service-local resource descriptor and input-source association. Global Resource resolution requires separate scoped identity evidence. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.

Retain service-scoped function identity and source references; no direct resource-ARN relationship is invented. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.

Retain each supplied service configuration member, including null/incomplete role entries, resource-discovery status/errors, report destination and Agent Space reference. These are not application authorization, report readiness or identity equivalence. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.

Retain the entire native cost observation, including supplied units/currency/provenance and unknown members, under the exact assessment Source version. The path is relative to the unwrapped assessment object. No typed AssessmentCost value, live pricing guarantee or recommendation implementation estimate is claimed.

Retain the entire native queryRange object with its window, granularity and every supplied timestamp/count entry. No top-level queryBuckets field is invented. DNS usage is not latency, request success or availability. Member paths are relative to the unwrapped source object. This is retained content, not a typed owned schema or an implemented adapter.

mappings.representation: Snapshot(kind=POLICY_CONTEXT).contents (PolicyContext) pins Observation and Source.effectiveTargets; ServiceStatus.policyContextSnapshot selects that context
mappings.preservedSemantics: Bundle references the exact effective-target observation used by its context, not an independently selected current target set.

mappings.representation: Projection.coverage[] and ServiceStatus.findingCoverage (Coverage); ServiceStatus.attentionReasons[] are strings, not a separate AttentionReason class
mappings.preservedSemantics: Explicit populations/counts, scope, freshness, reason codes and reducer version. Empty scope has no fabricated percentage or journey compliance.

mappings.representation: api/rpc.schema.json Page on list responses: traversalId/asOfSequence/createdAt/expiresAt and optional exact totalResults
mappings.preservedSemantics: Original snapshotId maps to traversalId. The response owns retained traversal timing/publication metadata and optional exact authorized result cardinality. Missing count remains unknown; local exhaustion never proves upstream completeness. This transport DTO has no canonical entity owner.

mappings.representation: Common entity version/createdAt/updatedAt; Command receipts; Source.subjectState (SubjectStateObservation) for evidenced visibility/deletion
mappings.preservedSemantics: Every entity requires version, createdAt and updatedAt. Exact history keeps the same identity. Command/tombstone evidence preserves effect and retention meaning; deleting local metadata does not cascade into captured evidence or claim native deletion.

Preserve original path, rawValue, normalizedValue and MISSING/UNKNOWN_ENUM/INVALID_VALUE reason under the exact Source and rule. Both values remain opaque to identity walking. Diagnostics do not erase raw evidence or create another entity.
Deduplicate service contributors and keep separate runtime-health, policy-posture and assessment-coverage counts with scope, as-of time and reducer version.
